title: EG&G as gatekeeper of Area 51
place_text: Area 51 / Groom Lake, Nevada; Las Vegas

tellings.quote: Area 51. In the early 1960s, EGNG's special projects division based in Las Vegas had been trusted to handle personnel screening, site access, transportation, and daily operations.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that in the early 1960s a special projects division of the company EG&G, based in Las Vegas, was trusted to run much of Area 51, a highly secret government base at Groom Lake in Nevada. According to Michels, it handled screening of staff, who got in, transport and daily operations. If true, it would make this company the gatekeeper of a place long linked to stories of hidden alien craft.
